text: “He is very handsome. One easily sees how it is. She thinks him the most elegant man in the world, the finest gentleman. She has never seen anything like him; he is better, even, than the courier. It was the courier probably who introduced him; and if he succeeds in marrying the young lady, the courier will come in for a magnificent commission.” “I don’t believe she thinks of marrying him,” said Winterbourne, “and I don’t believe he hopes to marry her.” “You may be very sure she thinks of nothing.
